# 🎯 Release: First Playwright Execution Layer (`v0.1.0`)

{{RELEASE_METADATA}}

## 📌 Summary
This release marks the first functional testing layer of the framework. It introduces **Playwright** and **TestNG** integration, a complete end‑to‑end test case (`TC_001`), and the initial TestNG suite configuration. The framework can now execute real browser automation against a demo website.

## 🛠 Key Changes
- [x] Added Playwright (`1.59.0`) and TestNG (`7.12.0`) to `pom.xml`
- [x] Created `TC_001` – Text Box form test on DemoQA
- [x] Set up browser lifecycle (`@BeforeTest` / `@AfterTest`) with headless mode
- [x] Added `testng.xml` to define the test suite
- [x] Validated that CI pipeline executes the test successfully

## ✅ Quality Assurance
- `mvn clean test` passes on Chromium, Firefox, WebKit (browsers can be switched later)
- `pom-validator.sh` reports all dependencies as **pass** (Playwright & TestNG meet version requirements)
- TestNG generates HTML/XML reports under `target/surefire-reports/`

## 📝 Release Notes
This PR promotes `v0.1.0` from `dev` to `main`. After merging, GitHub Actions will:
1. Create a signed Git tag `v0.1.0`
2. Generate a GitHub Release with auto‑notes
3. Bump `dev` to `v0.2.0-SNAPSHOT` (next minor version for logging & config)
4. Open a version bump PR (`chore/bump-to-v0.2.0`)

## 🔄 Post-Merge Automation
- Tag `v0.1.0` created on `main`
- GitHub Release published with changelog
- `dev` branch receives the next snapshot version (`0.2.0-SNAPSHOT`)
